description: A one-time link for the signed-in person to open in their own browser and allow Chockstone to read their Canva designs. Lasts 10 minutes. Afterwards canva_designs lists their designs.

app.description: The iPhone app: Canva sends the code back to the app, which finishes with canva_connect_finish

back.description: Where the web app returns to, a path starting /app/

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: canva_connect
title: Connect Canva
